profile.reading: This OpenStreetMap point in Maricopa County, Arizona, is tagged telecom=data_center and named "Emailage." Emailage is a real, notable Phoenix-area technology company -- a fraud-prevention and email-risk-scoring SaaS platform, acquired by LexisNexis Risk Solutions and now marketed as LexisNexis Emailage, per LexisNexis's own site. It is a software analytics company that consumes cloud and data center infrastructure to run its product, rather than a company that sells colocation or hosting services from this address. This registry treats this as a mistagged OpenStreetMap record for an office location rather than a genuine data center facility, and does not assert data-center-specific capacity or specifications for what is, by all available evidence, a corporate office.

reading.body:
This record tags an OpenStreetMap point as a data center, but research exhausted here indicates it is a corporate office for Emailage, a fraud-prevention and email-risk-scoring SaaS company acquired by LexisNexis Risk Solutions, not a colocation or hosting facility that sells data center capacity. No data-center-specific capacity specifications are published for this address.

Arizona has 56 mapped facilities tagged as data centers in OpenStreetMap, of which only four publish power capacity figures to this site, totaling 512 MW. This facility does not appear among those four with published specifications.

This campus does not qualify as a material AI infrastructure asset on currently available information. It should be treated as a mistagged office location until operator specifications clarify otherwise.
